close_reason: cert_has_san_identity() + working_issuer_is_san_identity flag; skips DN check for RFC 5280 §4.2.1.6 certs; test added
description: A certificate with an empty Subject and a critical SubjectAltName passes the critical extension guard but fails name linkage because names_match compares against the empty Subject DN. RFC 5280 §4.2.1.6 requires that when Subject is empty and SAN is critical, the SAN is used as the identity.
title: pkix-path: empty Subject + critical SAN fails name matching (RFC 5280 §4.2.1.6)
